limitations: Exact binary symplectic groups of size 2m with m>=2 only; constant and one-entry Walsh frequencies only; no statement for all group functions or odd characteristic. Earlier representation-theoretic equivalence is a residual historical risk.
scientific_integrity: The character-sum proof treats the full parameter range. Finite checks are corroboration, not a proof of generality. No independent external audit, certification, or historical-priority guarantee.
title: Complete coordinate Walsh-frame spectrum on binary symplectic groups
